cases.question: How many days of annual leave does the company provide?
cases.actual_answer:
Acme Corp Employee Leave Policy
================================

Annual Leave
------------
The company provides 20 days of annual leave per calendar year for full-time employees.
Unused annual leave may be carried over up to a maximum of 5 days into the next year.

Sick Leave
----------
Employees are entitled to 10 days of paid sick leave each year.
A medical certificate is required for absences longer than 3 consecutive days.

Notice Period
-------------
Employees must provide at least 14 days of advance notice when requesting annual leave,
except in emergency situations approved by a manager.

Holiday Closures
----------------
The company observes national public holidays. These days do not count against annual leave.

cases.question: What is the remote work policy?
cases.actual_answer:
Remote Work Guidelines
======================

Eligible employees may work remotely up to three days per week.
Core collaboration hours are 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM local time.
Employees must be reachable on company chat and email during core hours.
Equipment such as laptops and monitors may be requested through IT support.
Security: company VPN must be used when accessing internal systems from outside the office.
